mapper.select: SELECT route_id, fid, rname, fsname, lsname, city, province FROM public.routes ORDER BY fid

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'name', 'futian-bus-routes', 'crs', jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'name', 'properties', jsonb_build_object( 'name', 'urn:ogc:def:crs:OGC:1.3:CRS84' ) ), 'features', COALESCE( jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'properties', jsonb_build_object( 'fid', fid, 'rname', rname, 'fsname', fsname, 'lsname', lsname, 'city', city, 'province', province ), 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(geom)::jsonb ) ORDER BY fid ), '[]'::jsonb ) )::text FROM public.routes
